item.title: Reed glides to victory in Dubai Desert Classic
item.description: LIV Golf star Patrick Reed took his fourth title on the DP World Tour, winning the $9-million Dubai Desert Classic by four shots on Sunday.

item.title: Follett-Smith claims glory in Cell C Challenge
item.description: Zimbabwe’s Benjamin Follett-Smith claimed his third Sunshine Tour title when he won the Cell C Challenge in Honour of Gary Player.

item.title: Scheffler marches to season-opening PGA Tour win
item.description: World No 1 Scottie Scheffler launched his 2026 PGA Tour campaign with a runaway victory in the American Express at La Quinta, California.

item.title: Iceman De Bruin wins SA Amateur Proudfoot Trophy
item.description: Dewan de Bruin produced a moment of pure class to claim the Proudfoot Trophy in the South African Amateur Championship.

item.title: Cronje surges to the top in Big Easy Play Off
item.description: Dainel Cronje dazzled to an opening round of nine-under 63 on Tuesday, taking a two-stroke lead in the Betway Big Easy Tour Play Off event played at Modderfontein Golf Club.

item.title: Makama ignites SA Amateur match play
item.description: The first round of the knockout stages of the 2026 South African Amateur Championship at Pretoria Country Club on Tuesday delivered drama, upsets and emphatic victories.

item.title: Sunshine Tour players eye SDC Open glory
item.description: It’s the start of something big in the bushveld this week.

item.title: LIV Golf revamps 2026 format
item.description: LIV Golf has announced a series of competition and format changes for the 2026 season.

item.title: LIV Golf’s Reed to return to PGA Tour
item.description: Former Masters champion Patrick Reed says he is leaving LIV Golf and will return to the PGA Tour later this season.

item.title: Performance Engineered for the Modern Golfer
item.description: In a game where balance, precision, and confidence define success, footwear plays a far greater role than many golfers realise.
